name: attach-multi-upload (visual) — 요약 토스트 · 첨부 패널 판독 캡처 (authed, PB-0008 POST-DEPLOY)

steps.script: (async()=>{const cid=sessionStorage.getItem('__amuCid');const mk=(n,c)=>new File([c],n,{type:'text/plain'});const dt=new DataTransfer();['vis_a.sql','vis_b.sql','vis_c.sql'].forEach((n,i)=>dt.items.add(mk(n,'-- visual '+n+'\nSELECT '+(i+1)+';\n')));const el=document.getElementById('attachFileInput');el.files=dt.files;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));const t=document.getElementById('toast');let seen=null;for(let i=0;i<120;i++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));if(t&&t.classList.contains('is-visible')&&/첨부 3개 중/.test(t.textContent)){seen=t.textContent;break;}}return JSON.stringify({cid:cid,V1_summary_toast:seen,V1_visible:t?t.classList.contains('is-visible'):null,V1_bg:t?getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor:null});})()

(async()=>{const mk=(n,c)=>new File([c],n,{type:'text/plain'});const dt=new DataTransfer();['vis_a.sql','vis_b.sql','vis_c.sql'].forEach((n,i)=>dt.items.add(mk(n,'-- visual '+n+'\nSELECT '+(i+1)+';\n')));const el=document.getElementById('attachFileInput');el.files=dt.files;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));const t=document.getElementById('toast');let seen=null;for(let i=0;i<120;i++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));if(t&&t.classList.contains('is-visible')&&/변경 없음/.test(t.textContent)){seen=t.textContent;break;}}return JSON.stringify({V4_skip_toast:seen,V4_visible:t?t.classList.contains('is-visible'):null,V4_bg:t?getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor:null});})()
